description: Introducing the countdown timer by Based On - a tool designed with marketers, retailers, and end users in mind. This timer stands out for its adaptability, user-friendly interface, and simple yet powerful customization options, making it an ideal solution for dynamic online stores and promotional events. Designed for Any Scenario Adaptability is at the core of this countdown timer. With two modes - support for a single timer or up to five simultaneous timers - retailers can tailor the visual for anything from a sitewide flash sale to parallel limited offers. The visual automatically adjusts to any screen size, ensuring a clean look whether displayed on a large storefront monitor or a mobile device. As space gets tighter, labels shrink to single letters and margins become compact, so users always get the right info without distractions. Simple, Intuitive Customization Setting up and managing timers is frictionless. Four intuitive cards structure all settings: The primary card lets users switch between timers, simultaneously apply styles with 'same styles', hide empty timers, and set end dates easily - either by linking to real-time user data or by using a manual calendar/time picker.
